name: agntia-redes
description: Agntia Redes: servicio social SaaS (documentación + runtime en construcción)

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.slice:publish: npm run build && node scripts/run-slice.mjs publication
scripts.slice:reconcile: npm run build && node scripts/run-slice.mjs reconciliation
